name: mcp-bridge
title: MCP Bridge for ChatGPT
description: Host any npm MCP server as HTTP/SSE endpoint for ChatGPT

input.title: MCP Bridge Input
input.description: Configure which MCP server to host. Use either 'package' (npm install) or 'command' (custom command like npx).

package.title: NPM Package
package.description: npm package name to install and run (e.g., @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything). Leave empty if using 'command'.

version.title: Package Version
version.description: Optional: specific version to install (e.g., 1.0.0). Only used with 'package'.

command.title: Custom Command
command.description: Custom command to run (e.g., 'npx'). Use this instead of 'package' for npx-style commands.

args.title: CLI Arguments
args.description: Arguments to pass to the command (e.g., ['@smithery/cli@latest', 'run', '@executeautomation/playwright-mcp-server'])

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description: Optional: environment variables for the MCP server (e.g., API keys)
